£160 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious six-bedroom student maisonette on Myrtle Grove, ideally situated in the heart of Jesmond.

Perfect for student living, the property offers a comfortable and modern home, comprising a welcoming living room, a stylish fully fitted kitchen and six generously sized double bedrooms, alongside a well-appointed bathroom. The property also benefits from double glazing throughout.

Located in one of Jesmond-s most popular student areas, the maisonette is just a short walk from local amenities, excellent transport links and both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today!
